in_marathi.name: Ganvit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Ganas
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ganvit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit term ‘Gana’ meaning ‘group’ or ‘assembly’, and ‘Vit’ meaning ‘lord’. The name ‘Ganvit’ is believed to be a reference to the Lord of Ganas, the group of deities led by Lord Kubera in Hindu mythology. This name is often given to a child who is born on a Wednesday, as it is considered auspicious for those born on this day.
